description: Metadata write polish — review fixes, ModifyRequest refactor, batch concurrency
prTitle: fix: metadata write polish & batch concurrency (#128)
prBody:
## Summary

Follow-up to #127. Fixes all review issues, refactors `modify()` to use `ModifyRequest` struct for a clean public API, and wires up batch write concurrency with `RateLimiter` integration.

- `ModifyRequest` struct with owned data (no lifetimes) for ergonomic public API
- Batch write concurrency via `JoinSet` + `Semaphore` + `RateLimiter` (global 429 pause)
- Client-side collection last-removal enforcement
- Stronger test coverage (wiremock header matchers)
- Replace deprecated `atty` with `std::io::IsTerminal`
- DRY output helpers, fix spreadsheet dry-run summary

## Test Plan

- [x] `cargo test --workspace` — all tests pass
- [x] `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` — no warnings
- [x] All wiremock-based, zero live archive.org requests
- [x] Batch concurrency tested with concurrent wiremock mocks
- [x] 429 global pause verified in tests

Closes #128
Closes #129 #130 #131 #132 #133 #134 #135 #136

🤖 Generated with Ralph (automated implementation loop)
safetyRules: NEVER send real HTTP requests to archive.org — all tests use wiremock mocks
NEVER commit secrets, credentials, or .env files
ALWAYS run gh auth switch --user jjjake before any gh or git push command
NEVER push to any repo other than jjjake/ia

userStories.title: Wire batch write concurrency with RateLimiter integration
userStories.description: Implement concurrent batch metadata writes using JoinSet + Semaphore + RateLimiter. Both regular batch and spreadsheet modes. Default --jobs 2. Global 429 pause/resume. Clean output via mutex.
acceptanceCriteria: Batch writes use tokio::task::JoinSet with Arc<Semaphore>(jobs)
--jobs N controls concurrency (default 2)
429 response triggers RateLimiter::pause_for() which pauses ALL workers
All workers call rate_limiter.wait_if_paused() before each request
Workers resume only after pause duration expires
Failed request retried after 429 pause ends
Output lines don't intermix (Arc<Mutex<Stdout>> or similar)
Spreadsheet mode uses same concurrency pattern
Joblog writes remain thread-safe
Integration test: multiple items processed concurrently (verify with wiremock request timing)
Integration test: 429 pauses all workers (wiremock returns 429 for first, verify second waits)
Integration test: mixed success/error in batch
All tests use wiremock — zero live requests
cargo test --workspace passes
cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings passes
userStories.notes: Largest story. Follow download.rs pattern for JoinSet + Semaphore. RateLimiter already in ia-core/src/rate_limit.rs. Depends on US-001 (ModifyRequest) and US-006 (output helper).
